Dr Jones
Newtown Memory Clinic
400 Rail Rd
Newtown

19/04/2015

Dear Dr Jones
RE: Mrs Patricia Welshman, D.O.B : 28/03/1930

Thank you for seeing Mrs Patricia, an 88-year-old patient , whose features are consistent with Alzheimer's     Comment [Benchmark1]: Welshman
disease. Your further assessment would be highly appreciated.                                                  Comment [Benchmark2]: widow


Mrs Patricia is a widow with five children. However, she lives alone. Regarding her medical records, she is    Comment [Benchmark3]: Welshman
osteoporotic together with having dementia. Therefore, she was on Vitamin D, atorvastin, ibubrofen,            Comment [Benchmark4]: has
metoprolol and paracetamol. It is worth mentioning she has a family history of Alzheimer's.                    Comment [Benchmark5]: that


On 14/12/2014, she presented to me for her routine check-up as usual. At that time, her laboratory tests       Comment [Benchmark6]: Mrs.
                                                                                                               Welshman
were unremarkable except for an increase in LDL cholesterol level in addition to a deficiency in her Vitamin
D level. She reported that she had not taken her medication regularly. For which I suggested that she could
use a Webster pack. Two months later, her laboratory tests revealed a deterioration in her Vitamin D level
besides a more increase in the LDL cholesterol level. For this reason, she agreed to use the Webster pack.     Comment [Benchmark7]: further


Today, she came to the clinic along with her daughter and both were concerned about discussing some            Comment [Benchmark8]: the patient
memory issues from which she has been suffering recently including, missing social events, forgetting her      Comment [Benchmark9]: as
hair dresser, behavioural changes, as well as decision making issues. Consequently, a mini memory              Comment [Benchmark10]: started
assessment was carried out which showed a poor short-term memory.                                              Comment [Benchmark11]: experienci
                                                                                                               ng
                                                                                                               Comment [Benchmark12]: facing
In view of the above, I am referring her for further management in order to rule out Alzheimer's disease.
                                                                                                               Comment [Benchmark13]: Should
                                                                                                               you require any further information, please
Yours sincerely,                                                                                               do not hesitate to contact me.
Doctor.

 Comments                     An effort to cover and organise relevant case notes
                              is visible. However, there are several mistakes
                              mainly pertaining to sentence formation and word
                              choice. Overall, the letter needs further
                              improvement.
 Estimated Grade               C+
 Advice                       1. Pay more attention to grammar and improve
                                  sentences.
                              2. Need to improve word choice.
                              3. Keep practicing to improve your performance.
